sources: Songle SRD series data sheet (单组转换型 7A/10A/15A, two pages, no revision printed), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/9ddfe54b7529126320ff1ddcabf6bab7.pdf?productCode=C35449, read 2026-11-03
ordering information p. 1: SRD-05VDC-S L-C = 5 V coil, S sealed, L 0.36 W coil, C changeover (1C)
coil table p. 1, 0.36 W (L), 5 VDC: 71.4 mA, 70 Ω ±10 %, pick-up 75 % max (3.75 V), drop-out 10 % min (0.5 V), overload 130 % (6.5 V, v_coil_max_v)

contact data p. 1: contact resistance 100 mΩ (1 A 6 VDC), load 7 A / 10 A / 15 A at 250 VAC by version, max. switching voltage 250 VAC; safety approvals p. 2 (CQC, TÜV): 10 A 250 VAC – the ESPurna-H README calls it a 10 A relay: i_contact_max_a and i_switch_max_a 10 A, v_max_v 250 (an AC rms value)
insulation p. 1: coil to contacts 1500 VAC 1 min, open contacts 1000 VAC 1 min; −40 … +85 °C

pins: PCB drawing p. 2 (bottom view, C type): coil between the two pins of one column, common the offset pin beside it, NC the contact closed at rest, NO the other – the EasyEDA footprint of C35449 (edakit part import, pad positions): pad 5 the offset pin (common), pads 1 and 4 the coil, pad 3 NC, pad 2 NO; the ESPurna-H Eagle package SRD-5VDC-SL-C (COMMON, COIL1/COIL2, OPEN, CLOSED) rotated by 180° gives the same pads

checked: coil data of the 5 V 0.36 W coil
pinout from the bottom view against the footprint's pads
open: the coil has no polarity: coil_plus is the pin on 5V in this design
the version's current rating (7, 10 or 15 A) is not in the part number; 10 A taken from the approvals and the design's README
the contact rating is an AC rms value; edakit compares voltages as DC – the relay's v_max_v is not held to a net (a relay is no passive part in LIM.v)
